description: This file defines the LocalizationService class in the OrangeHRM system, providing methods for managing localization, language support, translation validation, import/export, and handling of XLIFF files within the Human Resource Management system's admin module.

classes.name: LocalizationService
classes.description: Service class providing functionalities for localization management, including language support, translation validation, import/export via XLIFF, and error handling within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: getLocalizationDao
methods.description: Returns the LocalizationDao instance, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: getI18NService
methods.description: Retrieves the I18NService instance from the container.

methods.name: getLocalizationDateFormats
methods.description: Returns available localization date formats with example representations.

methods.name: getSupportedDateFormats
methods.description: Provides a list of supported date format strings and their labels.

methods.name: getCurrentDateFormat
methods.description: Returns the currently configured default date format.

methods.name: getSupportedLanguages
methods.description: Fetches an array of supported languages that are added and enabled.

methods.name: searchLanguages
methods.description: Searches for languages based on provided filter parameters.

methods.name: getLanguagesArray
methods.description: Normalizes and returns an array of language models.

methods.name: saveAndUpdateTranslatedStringsFromRows
methods.description: Saves or updates translated language strings from provided rows for a specific language.

methods.name: saveImportErrorLangStringsFromRows
methods.description: Saves import error language strings from input rows for a given language and employee.

methods.name: createTranslatedItemsFromRows
methods.description: Creates I18NTranslation objects from input rows for a specific language.

methods.name: createImportErrorItemsFromRows
methods.description: Creates I18NImportError objects from input rows indicating errors.

methods.name: generateLangStringLanguageKey
methods.description: Generates a unique key string for language translations.

methods.name: exportLanguagePackage
methods.description: Exports language data as an XLIFF package (XML string).

methods.name: getXliffXmlSources
methods.description: Constructs an XML DOM document representing the language group translations for export.

methods.name: getTargetLanguageFromFile
methods.description: Extracts the target language code from an XLIFF DOM document.

methods.name: validateTargetString
methods.description: Validates translation strings for syntax errors and placeholder consistency.

methods.name: getI18NErrorByName
methods.description: Retrieves an I18NError entity by its name.

methods.name: processXliffFile
methods.description: Validates and processes an uploaded XLIFF file for a specific language.

methods.name: validateXliffFile
methods.description: Checks if an XLIFF file content is well-formed and matches expected language.

methods.name: validateLangStrings
methods.description: Validates all language strings in an XLIFF document, categorizing into valid, invalid, and skipped.

methods.name: languageHasImportErrors
methods.description: Checks if a language has import errors for a specific employee.

methods.name: clearImportErrorsForLangStrings
methods.description: Clears import errors for specified language strings.
